messages.author: bb0d51bd5af5ac0d
messages.subject: inference on cross-covariance
parts:
Hello,

I'm following this tutorial to run INLA with linear co-regionalization model (LMC) for multivariate modeling: https://becarioprecario.bitbucket.io/spde-gitbook/ch-manipula.html
Is there a way to get inference (or simply some estimate) of the cross-covariance/cross-correlation among variables in the multivariate model (LMC) base on INLA results?

Thanks,
Wendy

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] inference on cross-covariance
parts:
You can always use inla.posterior.sample() to generate samples and (to
keep it easy), use inla.posterior.sample.eval() to evaluate statistics
from samples, like corr-correlations
